title: AI Demand Leak Audit — Portfolio Sample
sampleSubtext: Sample for demonstration only — not a live client deliverable
limitedDiagnosticDisclaimer: This is a limited diagnostic, not a full ADP monitoring report. No portfolio strategy was assumed. Results are based on a controlled sample of monitored AI responses. AI outputs can vary by provider, timing, prompt framing, and available source signals.

portfolioAuditContext.title: Portfolio Audit Context
portfolioAuditContext.body: This portfolio sample identifies inferred demand leaks based on monitored AI results. It does not assume the portfolio’s confirmed commercial priorities. The purpose is to show which hotels and demand segments may warrant leadership review.

portfolioSummary: This portfolio sample reviews 3 hotels across monitored AI demand scenarios. The goal is to identify where AI visibility may support commercial opportunity and where hotels may be missing or displaced by competitors.

portfolioPattern.title: Portfolio Pattern
portfolioPattern.body: The portfolio pattern is not broad invisibility. The issue is inconsistent AI recognition by use case. Some hotels are visible for general leisure demand but weaker for the specific segments that may represent growth opportunity. This may matter for owners and regional leaders because AI can shape the early consideration set before the traveler reaches brand.com, OTAs, or the hotel website.

howToUseThis.title: How to Use This
howToUseThis.body: For leadership, the roll-up is a triage tool. It shows where AI may be misaligned with a hotel’s likely demand opportunity, but the owner/operator should confirm which demand areas actually matter before execution.
